subjects.name: QAnon: An Invitation to the Great Awakening

summary: A random-page reading of QAnon: An Invitation to the Great Awakening, a 2019 bestseller compiled from anonymous QAnon followers that recasts Trump as a hero fighting a satanic elite child-trafficking cabal.
keywords: Where We Go One We Go All

evidence.note: Host introduces the book, credited to the WWG1WGA collective, as a former Amazon number-two bestseller
Passage decoding Trump's 2018 Tampa rally remarks as a signal to Q followers
Long podcast-transcript chapter claiming an organized nationwide pedophile network
Chapter on satanic bloodline elites, child sacrifice and adrenochrome claims
Hosts discuss followers cut off from families and call the movement a cult
Book's glossary on 8chan and how Q posts drops there; hosts on its online origin
Book noted as published in 2019; Q posts discussed date from 2018

notes: The book is credited to the pseudonymous collective WWG1WGA (anonymous followers), so no author is listed as a primary subject and roles are empty; QAnon is the movement the book promotes. covered_span starts at QAnon's 2017 origin, which the book narrates; Q posts and Trump events cited run 2018-2019. cults-new-religions is the hosts' framing of the movement, not a formal group.
